audit_item: M0.1 / Native batch and online fill arithmetic under Decimal context
finding: Native batch fill rows and the online accumulator summary path could use caller-controlled Decimal precision. At precision 3, a 12.34 fill for quantity 12345 was rounded to turnover 152000.0 instead of 152337.30, and slippage 123.00 instead of 123.45.
change: Both batch and online summary fill accounting now use bounded exact Decimal multiply/add/subtract helpers, context-independent SELL sign handling, and explicit finite/precision errors. The exact helpers retain the 4096-digit operation cap.

verification.pytest_installed_wheel: Same 16-test selector with PYTHONPATH unset and freshly rebuilt rles-research 0.4.1 installed in RouteB .venv-win-app: 16 passed in 0.64s.

scope: Synthetic unit fixtures under a precision-3 Decimal context only; no live account, market, registry, or evaluation payload was accessed. The broad Windows PR selector has not been rerun after this focused change.
